title: AI Assistant

v1.title: Drop your bills and screenshots here
v1.body: Paste an App Store receipt, a charge SMS, a subscription page screenshot or any text. I'll turn it into subscription drafts for you to confirm. You can also ask about your spending.

v2.title: Where did this month's money go?
v2.body: Ask what's due this month, which charges cost the most, or how much you've spent this year. I'll look it up in your ledger.

v3.title: Charge alerts? Hand them over
v3.body: Paste a bank, wallet or carrier charge notice. I'll work out which subscription it is and how much was charged, and record it.

v4.title: One screenshot, a whole page of subscriptions
v4.body: Send a screenshot of your App Store subscriptions or a membership page. I'll split it into drafts, one per subscription, for you to confirm.

v5.title: Price went up? Tell me from when
v5.body: Say "Netflix is 17.99 from next month" and I'll change the price from that date. Earlier charges stay as they were.

v6.title: Done with it? Just say so
v6.body: Not renewing, stopping now, or shut down by the provider: I know the difference, and can record a refund at the same time.

v7.title: I'll keep the shared-plan math
v7.body: Splitting a family plan? Tell me each person's share and who has paid. I'll track members and payments so you can see who still owes what.

v8.title: Found a year of bills?
v8.body: Paste a monthly bill table. I'll create one subscription per column and record each month's actual amount in its history.

v9.title: Which subscriptions can go?
v9.body: Ask for ones you don't use, duplicates or the biggest price hikes. I'll pull them from your ledger as a list you could cancel.

v10.title: What's charging next week?
v10.body: Ask about the next few days or the rest of the month. I'll list the charges by date so you can plan ahead.

v11.title: Foreign-currency plans, sorted
v11.body: Turkish or Nigerian store prices stay in their own currency. I convert them at that day's rate, and can record what your card was actually charged.

v12.title: Receipt emails: just copy everything
v12.body: No need to pick out the details from Apple, Google or Spotify receipts. Paste the whole email and I'll find the amount, cycle and date.

v13.title: Add a subscription you've had for years
v13.body: Say "since 2021, 8 at first, 18 now" and I'll fill in the price history so your lifetime spending is accurate.

v14.title: How much on subscriptions this year?
v14.body: Ask about this year, last year or any range. I'll break it down by category or payment method.

v15.title: Don't forget to cancel that trial
v15.body: Tell me when the trial ends. I'll record it so you get a reminder before it converts.

v16.title: Paying for someone else? Keep track
v16.body: Tell me a subscription is paid on someone's behalf and I'll track what you paid and what you got back, separately.

v17.title: Switched region or plan?
v17.body: Moved from the US store to Turkey, or upgraded to Family? Tell me when, and I'll continue on the new plan and keep the old history.

v18.title: Ask anything, casually
v18.body: "Which subscription have I had longest?" "Which card is charged most?" Just ask and I'll check the ledger.

v19.title: You confirm every change
v19.body: I only draft. New subscriptions, price changes and cancellations appear as cards, and nothing is saved until you confirm.

v20.title: Start your ledger here
v20.body: Send a receipt, a screenshot, or just tell me what you subscribe to. I'll handle the rest.
